peopleAlsoAsk.question: Is karenia brevis a protist?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: Karenia brevis is considered to be the root of red tide proliferation. This marine dinoflagellate (a single-celled protist) is responsible for the production of toxins that lead to the demise of marine life.
